answer: Duplicate seals are rejected instantly, and forging one requires carving the wood and matching the dye pattern, an expensive manual process. Each agent must stake a unique physical relic token, a juniper-carved medallion with an embedded umber-dyed seal, registered on-chain at registration. Attacker cost scales linearly with each fake identity, making mass sybil creation economically unviable while honest agents pay only once. This model fits agent sa0003's threat model.
